name: CSA B64 Series (Backflow Preventers and Cross-Connection Control)
description: The CSA B64 series covering backflow preventers and their field testing, applied through the Ontario Building Code Part 7 and, more stringently, through municipal cross-connection control by-laws. The auditable obligations are almost entirely about certified testers and records: a backflow preventer must be tested on installation and at least annually by a certified tester, and the test report filed with the municipality. Because enforcement is municipal, requirements differ between Hamilton, Brantford and Niagara — a single company-wide assumption is a defect. Testers hold a certification that expires and must be recertified.
authority: CSA Group / municipal cross-connection control programmes
scope: Plumbing contractors installing, testing or maintaining backflow prevention devices

families.name: Hazard Assessment and Device Selection
families.description: Choosing the right device for the assessed hazard — the technical decision an inspector second-guesses.

controls.name: Cross-Connection Survey and Hazard Assessment
controls.description: Cross-connections are identified and the severity of hazard assessed (severe, moderate, minor) so device selection follows the hazard rather than habit.

controls.name: Device Selection and Installation
controls.description: The device type matches the assessed hazard and application, is installed in the correct orientation and location with required clearances, and is accessible for testing.

controls.name: Municipal By-Law Variance Tracking
controls.description: Cross-connection control requirements are tracked per municipality served, since enforcement, submission routes and test frequency differ by jurisdiction.

families.name: Testing, Certification and Records
families.description: Where this standard actually bites: certified testers, calibrated gauges and filed reports.

controls.name: Certified Backflow Tester Currency
controls.description: Field testing is performed only by persons holding current backflow prevention tester certification, with expiry tracked and recertification completed before lapse.

controls.name: Test Gauge Calibration
controls.description: Differential pressure test gauges are calibrated at the required interval with certificates retained, since an uncalibrated gauge invalidates every test performed with it.

controls.name: Initial and Annual Testing
controls.description: Devices are tested on installation, after repair, and at least annually thereafter, with the schedule tracked so no device lapses.

controls.name: Test Report Submission and Retention
controls.description: Test reports are completed, provided to the owner and submitted to the municipal authority where required, and retained for the required period.

controls.name: Failed Device Repair and Isolation
controls.description: A device failing a test is repaired or replaced and retested, with the potable supply protected in the interim and the failure recorded.
